mission: Organise the treasure to activate the vault.
description: Build a Max Heap using bottom-up swaps.
hints: A Max Heap is a complete binary tree.
Every parent must be greater than or equal to its children.
Start from the last non-leaf node and work upwards.

description: Restore the Max Heap using sift operations.
hints: Sift-up is used when a node may be larger than its parent.
Sift-down is used when a parent may be smaller than its children.
Compare a node with its parent or largest child, depending on the operation.

mission: Steal the greatest treasure from the vault.
description: Extract maximum values and sort the heap.
hints: The root always contains the maximum value.
Swap the root with the last element in the active heap.
Reduce the heap size and apply sift-down to restore the heap.

mission: Complete Heap Sort before the alarm reaches its limit.
description: Sort the heap by extracting maximum values.
hints: Build a Max Heap before starting extraction.
Each extraction places the current maximum in its final sorted position.
Only heapify the unsorted portion of the array.

mission: Complete the final Heap Sort challenge.
description: Build a Max Heap and sort the array to unlock the vault.
hints: First convert the array into a Max Heap.
Repeatedly move the maximum element to the end.
Restore the heap using sift-down until only one element remains.
